attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries no asterisk. None of the corpus's many Theodores is a bishop of Pavia. The page gives 743 for his election and 778 for his death, so the `dates` object carries the death alone; `confessor` is used because the page says he suffered much for the Orthodox faith and was exiled, and does not call his death a martyrdom. No hymn.
